svg.aria-label: FastPatch features. Diagnoses before it fixes: Five timestamped checks run on every machine before anything is touched. Names the real cause: One label from a shared vocabulary, so every engineer reads the same answer. Fixes inside your policy: Only the approved path for that cause, rolled out one machine group at a time. Proof, not job status: Done means the update is installed after the restart, not that a job ran. Ticket-ready output: Status, cause and action on one line per machine. The NOC works exceptions only. Nothing new to install: Runs inside the Kaseya VSA you already have, as a signed procedure per group.
